report.summary: Both failures come from one product defect: GET /api/books and the books page return every user's books when the leak_books seeded bug is active. The new user's bookshelf in the UI shows other users' rows, and the API list includes another user's book id. First, find out why BUGS=leak_books is set in the environment that runs CI (the workflow file does not set it), then fix list_books so it always filters by owner_id.

causes.title: list_books returns every user's books when leak_books is enabled
causes.explanation: list_books() in app/main.py takes a leak_books branch that runs SELECT * FROM books with no owner filter, so any user's list includes books owned by others. The API test expects other users' lists to exclude the book, and it fails because it does not. The UI test expects a brand-new user's bookshelf to be empty, but render_books() calls list_books(user['id']) and the template renders every row, so the page shows other users' books and the empty-state element is never rendered. Both tests are asserting correct behavior, so the failures point at the app. The leak_books branch is only reachable through the BUGS env var, so it is either set in the CI environment or left over from a seeded-bug run; the workflow file does not set it. Confidence is high that the leak is the cause. The exact source of the BUGS setting is not confirmed by the repo.
evidence: tests\api\test_books_api.py:42: assert 2 not in [1, 2]  (other user's list contains the first user's book id 2)
app/main.py:163-164: if "leak_books" in BUGS: rows = conn.execute("SELECT * FROM books ORDER BY id").fetchall()
app/main.py:166: normal path filters with WHERE owner_id = ?, so the leak only happens in the seeded-bug branch
app/main.py:270: "books": list_books(user["id"]) feeds the books.html template
tests\ui\test_login_ui.py:14: expect(books.empty_state).to_be_visible() failed with element(s) not found
Aria snapshot of the new user's page lists rows 'Final title Someone 2001 Delete' and 'From API-4e61aebb Robot Delete', which belong to other users' books, not this newly registered user

app/templates/books.html:30: the empty-state

only renders when books is empty, so the leaked rows hide it
The workflow .github/workflows/tests.yml does not set BUGS; no other code in the repo sets it either
causes.suggested_fix: First, check the environment of the CI job and remove BUGS=leak_books (or any stray BUGS setting) from it, then rerun both suites. Second, if the leak is meant to stay out of production code, remove the leak_books branch from list_books and always filter by owner_id. Add a regression test that a second user's list is empty for a fresh account.
